an4.45:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an4.45:1.2: athakho rohitasso devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho rohitasso devaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an4.45:2.1: yattha nu kho bhante na jāyati na jiyyati na miyyati na cavati na upapajjati sakkā nu kho bhante gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vāti.
an4.45:2.2: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jiyyati na miyyati na cavati na upapajjati nāhantaṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyanti vadāmīti.
an4.45:3.3: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jiyyati na miyyati na cavati na upapajjati nāhantaṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyanti vadāmīti
an4.45:4.1: bhūtapubbāhaṃ bhante rohitasso nāma isi ahosiṃ bhojaputto iddhimā vehāsaṃgamo
an4.45:4.2: tassa mayhaṃ bhante evarūpo javo ahosi seyyathāpi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho susikkhito katahattho katupāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya
an4.45:4.3: evarūpo padavītihāro ahosi seyyathāpi nāma puratthimā samuddā pacchimo samuddo
an4.45:4.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhante evarūpena javena samannāgatassa evarūpena ca padavītihārena evarūpaṃ icchāgataṃ uppajji
an4.45:4.6: so kho ahaṃ bhante aññatreva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvāva lokassa antaṃ antarāyeva kālakato
an4.45:5.3: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati ma jiyyati na miyyati na cavati na upapajjati nāhantaṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyanti vadāmīti.
an4.45:6.1: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jiyyati na miyyati na cavati na upapajjati nāhantaṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyanti vadāmi
an4.45:6.2: na cāhaṃ āvuso appatvāva lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmi
an4.45:6.3: apicāhaṃ āvuso imasmiṃyeva byāmamatte kaḷevare sasaññamhi samanake lokañca paññāpemi lokasamudayañca lokanirodhañca lokanirodhagāminiñca paṭipadanti.
